relationships.evidence_section: S1 Products: overview of processing levels
relationships.evidence_quote: All products, with the exception of Extended Timing Annotation Dataset (ETAD), are currently processed directly from the Level-0 product.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 2: made by ESA's IPF from the Sentinel-1D Level-0 data take (PARENT). Generic "Level-0 product" mapped to SENTINEL-1D_RAW by platform; same datatake IDs in both collections (Step 6b).

supporting_evidence.quote: Level 0 products are the basis from which all other high level products are produced.

relationships.evidence_quote: From data in each acquisition mode, the Instrument Processing Facility (IPF) generates focused Level-1 Single Look Complex (SLC) products and Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) products.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 4: SLC and GRD are both outputs of IPF Level-1 post-processing; GRD is not made from distributed SLC files.

supporting_evidence.quote: The Level-1 post-processing then generates the output Level-1 SLC products and the Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) products.

relationships.evidence_quote: Note that inputs of L2 algorithms are internal SLC and GRD products, which can be processed with dedicated configuration, and are called SL2 and GR2, respectively.
relationships.rationale: Decision step 4: OCN wind (OWI) is made from an internal GR2 product in the same IPF run, not from this collection's files.

supporting_evidence.quote: From internally generated Level-1 SLC and GRD products, the Level-2 Ocean (OCN) products are produced.

relationships.evidence_quote: GRD products are further classified by resolution (Full, High or Medium).
relationships.rationale: Same GRD family and polarization mode, other resolution class. Operationally IW/SM are produced High and EW Medium, so the two come from different acquisitions.

supporting_evidence.quote: EW: Medium resolution (with IPF being able to generate High and Medium resolution products)

relationships.evidence_document: ASF Synthetic Aperture Radar Product User Guide: SENTINEL-1 SAR Data Products
relationships.evidence_quote: Supports operation in single polarization (HH or VV) and dual polarization (HH+HV or VV+VH)
relationships.rationale: Same GRD resolution class, other polarization mode. Polarization is set at acquisition, so there is no shared run or data dependency.

relationships.rationale: Decision step 1: ASF makes one ISO XML metadata granule from each SAFE product of this collection (names match, Step 6b). The record labels it SCIENCE ASSOCIATED.
